name: Agri Warehouse Receipt (eNWR)
description: A WDRA-style electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt tokenized as fungible units (ERC-20) where 1 token = 1 quintal of crop held in an accredited warehouse — the same shape as gold-egr, generalized from bullion to agri commodities. A warehouse operator issues receipts against a physical deposit (mint, gated behind maker-checker approval since it asserts both a physical stock position and its market value), the depositing farmer can pledge the receipt to an NBFC or bank as loan collateral (freeze = lien) — the whole point of a WDRA-accredited warehouse receipt is that verifiable, de-risked collateral prices materially cheaper than unsecured credit, which is exactly why the scheme exists. Transfer records negotiation/assignment of the receipt (the same 'transfer = ownership of the claim' semantics used across every RWA instrument tonight). Burn is a physical withdrawal from the warehouse — gated behind maker-checker since releasing real stored grain needs a second pair of eyes, same as gold-egr's bullion release. The receipt id is enforced unique so one physical deposit is tokenized only once; the quality/grading certificate stays off-ledger with only its hash on-chain.

receiptId.description: WDRA electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (eNWR) number the warehouse operator issues against a physical deposit — enforced unique so one deposit is tokenized only once

warehouseOperator.description: WDRA-accredited warehouse operator holding the physical crop

farmerDepositor.description: Farmer or FPO who deposited the crop

commodity.description: Stored commodity, e.g. Wheat, Paddy, Soybean, Turmeric, Chana

grade.description: Quality grade per WDRA grading norms, e.g. FAQ (Fair Average Quality), Grade A

quantityQuintals.description: Stored quantity in quintals — 1 token = 1 quintal

expiryDate.description: Storage validity / warehouse insurance coverage end date (YYYY-MM-DD)

marketValuePerQuintalInr.description: Reference mandi price per quintal at deposit (INR) — the basis a lender uses for loan-to-value

totalDepositValueInr.description: Total value of this deposit (quantityQuintals × marketValuePerQuintalInr), INR — drives the platform's own valuation display

financierName.description: NBFC or bank the receipt is currently pledged to, if any — informational only; the actual lien is enforced via the freeze action, not this field

qualityCertificateUrl.description: Off-ledger link to the grading/quality certificate (only its hash lives on-ledger)

qualityCertificateHash.description: SHA-256 of the quality certificate (pins the off-ledger document as proof)
